candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the common Chinese-derived "-ang" or "-ong" rime endings.
This vector represents national, geographic, and cultural identities associated with European and global countries and regions.
This vector activates on word roots, suffixes, and morphological components related to spatial orientation and continental or regional designations across multiple languages.
This feature vector relates to concepts of imperialism, royalty, and historical colonial power structures.
These tokens are suffixes and root endings characteristic of Portuguese and Spanish verbs in their infinitive or conjugated forms.
This feature vector activates on common word prefixes, prefixes of proper nouns, and short, foundational English root words starting with specific capital or lowercase letters.
This vector activates for common prefixes, roots, and morphemes found across various Romance and Germanic languages.
This feature vector represents names and words starting with the root "Fran-" or "franc-".
This feature vector represents concepts related to the Americas and pan-American identity.

This vector activates for words, names, and roots originating from or commonly used in Romance and Germanic languages, particularly involving concepts of completeness, inclusion, and historical or cultural proper nouns.
